The cutoff compares the whole head minus status and done_on, so a merged replan that only adds a field such as a new input or a risk also refuses the verdict. That is what the outcome says: any replan from main that edits a doing item's head beyond status and done_on needs a fresh verdict once merged into the build branch.

checkDoneOn counts a ## Done on change section as said only when its text differs from the base's, so a second date move must rewrite the section; a replan that moves the date back with the old reason left in place is refused, which reads as intended.
